jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 부속지번 lane `building-register-sub-parcel` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0395): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_register_sub_parcel already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, compare it, in the publisher's DuckDB, with the table's current rows key bucket by key bucket and append to main only the rows of the registers whose sub-parcel set changed and a removal marker per vanished register (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). Two of the duckdb pool's runs go at a time, lanes or other in-process work: each holds one of its slots and a memory_claim on its unit (root ADR-0599, ADR-0605).
jobs.memory_measured: 2026-11-21, building-register-units. Under 16G: three runs, export 6m47s-7m00s CPU and about 10 minutes of wall time, `memory peak` 13.3-13.4G. Under the 8G this cap was for one day: one run, 61 minutes (17:37:58-18:39:25Z), 10m35s CPU, `memory peak` 7.2G - the export child held 6.68G resident and the cgroup sat at MemoryHigh with 18,933 `high` events and no OOM kill: throttled, not killed. journal `memory peak` 2026-10-18..11-08, 84 runs under 16G: highest 15,668M on 2026-10-20 (building-register-unit-areas). The other lanes measured on the DuckDB path the same day: 0.3G-7.1G.
jobs.memory_headroom_why: A measured working point, not 1.5 x a peak: the export sizes its workers to three quarters of what its cgroup has left, so its peak follows the cap, but about 7G of it does not shrink - at 8G nothing was left for it to work in. 16G is the cap under which the largest export is measured to finish in ten minutes. One number for all 54 lanes, because they share one unit template: it over-reserves for the small lanes (1-7G), and a request per lane comes with the Dagster resource tags that replace this admission (root ADR-0583 follow-up).

expected_outcome.basis: building HUB files are released monthly (expected_cadence monthly, 1080 h, in the endpoint catalog) plus one daily fallback; measured 2026-11-11 from each unit's journal, 10-12..11-11 (read-only): changed once.

assets.title: 건축물대장 부속지번
assets.description: 건물이 함께 선 다른 필지(부속지번)를 대장(관리건축물대장PK)마다 여러 행으로: 대장 대지의 PNU 와 부속 필지의 PNU(sub_pnu) 둘을 싣는다. 건물↔필지 다리다(place-identity, 루트 ADR-0288). 원문 33칸 보존. 읽는 소비자(필지·건물 by-PNU 패널)는 다음 PR 이라 그때까지 섬으로 둔다(루트 ADR-0395).

dependencies.description: 부속지번(mart_djy_05) 33칸을 관리건축물대장PK 마다 바뀐 대장의 행 묶음만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0395).
dependencies.pnu_resolution: pnu and sub_pnu composed at Silver by the Rust hub export (export-*-silver-handoff, standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes / ADR-0145), not a raw provider code; sub_pnu is null where the 시군구 crosswalk refuses a retired code and its raw codes stay for the place-identity resolver at the consumer (ADR-0288, ADR-0395 §3)
